[exit 0]

[exit 1]

[exit 2]

$ lint run --strikt src

[exit 2]

$ lint run

[exit 2]

$ lint run --max-issues many src

[exit 2]

$ LINT_RUN_FORMAT=xml lint run src

[exit 2]

$ lint -c lint.json run src

[exit 2]

$ lint run src >/dev/full

[exit 1]
